_doc: The voxgig libraries the Ruby port loads from checkouts, pinned by commit:
none is published as a gem. `make rb-libs` clones each at its pin, and
`make rb-deps` verifies the pins and links the checkouts under ruby/vendor/,
the one place the port loads them from. `home` names the variable that
points at an existing checkout instead. station is the main revision
go/go.mod binds; sekreto is the revision station's CI pins; plugin is the
revision station's CI resolves from voxgig/plugin's main.
